summary: Remote-controlled PTY and filesystem/upgrade surface over configurable WebSocket
details: The @yeaft/webchat-agent package installs an agent that connects to a WebSocket server URL taken from configuration (ctx.CONFIG.serverUrl) and dispatches messages from that server into privileged local operations. A `terminal_create` message spawns a bash/PowerShell/cmd PTY and `terminal_input` messages are written directly into that PTY via `term.pty.write(msg.data)`, giving whoever controls the configured server arbitrary command execution on the host running the agent. The same message router exposes handlers for `write_file`, `delete_files`, `git_push`, and `upgrade_agent`; `handleUpgradeAgent` runs `npm install <pkg>@latest` and re-executes the newly fetched code, so a server operator can also rewrite files on disk, push to git repositories the host has credentials for, and force the agent to replace itself with whatever is currently published as the latest version. This constitutes a network-controlled shell and filesystem-mutation channel whose blast radius on any host that runs the agent equals full-host RCE by the party operating the configured WebSocket endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
